newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sberbank rated good investment.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sberbank rated good investment.

text.p: Russian brokerage Renaissance Capital rated biggest bank Sberbank a good investment in the next year due to its dominant position in the banking sector, the broker said on Friday.

"With a virtual monopoly in the Russian financial sector and expectations of another good year in 1997, Sberbank should remain an attractive investment for the next 12 months," Renaissance Capital said in a research note.
"Owing to the nature of its special market position, Sberbank may be viewed as a sensible hedge against uncertainty."
As the only financial institution backed by government guarantees, Sberbank now holds over 70 percent of Russian household deposits. It also has 30,000 branches across Russia.
Sberbank is exempt from capital requirement regulations and will develop quicker than its rivals, the note said.
It said the position will not change in the next 12 months, but this will probably be unsustainable in the long term.

"Considering the franchise value of the bank and the present valuation level, we see few reasons for concern at present, and forecast a conservative nine-month price target of $200 for the common stock, implying a 40 percent annualised return on investment," the note said.
It was based on Thursday's closing price of $187.0. Already by Friday's close Sberbank was $194.0.
